definition.baseline_handoff: unchanged v1 uncertain refusal; immediate zero residual
definition.early_trigger: explicit scheduled intervention; not a prediction
definition.handoff: one irreversible episode-local latch; no reentry in this diagnostic
definition.selected_handoff: unchanged selected actor, slew from actual preceding correction and issued history
definition.unsupported: original unsupported refusal to deterministic baseline, including after selected handoff
definition.warning_after_handoff: retain shadow prediction; never return control to the challenge actor

warning_definition.leave: 30 consecutive supported scores strictly below exit_threshold
warning_definition.target: first physical violation or safe-no-actuation in the next 30 commands

definition.warning_trigger: first frozen natural withdrawal request, including unsupported observations
